The dev log is the team's memory. Every time someone works on the project, they add a short post here (a folder under `devlog/posts/` with an `index.qmd`), following the loop the course teaches: what was asked, what the agent or the person produced, how it was verified, and what changed as a result. Entries are dated and tagged by phase so the [activities](../tracker/activities.qmd) page and the log can be read side by side.
